But it does not cover the runs leg. Its label, mechanism ('RBI opportunity is the probability distribution of runners and outs when the hitter bats, derived from the hitters ahead') and rationale are RBI-only. Fix: patch the chain's measurement/mechanism to output per-PA run-scoring probability.
